codeAndLocalEvidence.claim: Worker composes one existing runtime/executor stack; PiAgentRuntime is constructed without modelCallObserver.
Existing persistent Run/Attempt/ExternalEffect/ComputerExecutionLease and versioned Artifact primitives.
Executor already resolves scoped models/tools/effect approval and injects repository_search guidance.
Run-scoped request has IDs/onUsage/fallback resolvers; constructor observer metadata lacks this scope; default context is retrieval.
Shared Pi observer, per-target fallback stream, and child stream hook; trusted connection identity must remain target-specific.
observedPiStream generates callId, reserves before call, awaits producer usage, settles observer; guarded SDK retries disabled.
Usage deduplication and producer/consumer guard already exist; preserve them when adding financial settlement.
Budget has finite insert-only allocation, atomic account/lane reservation and conservative hold, not a complete settlement/refund implementation.
Repository retrieval is all-term substring matching with simple name score and alphabetical tie-break.
repository_search gives bounded untrusted source candidates, not installation permission.
Source/pin/not-archived filters and singleton return do not establish semantic fit; source_only remains advisory.
Real pinned HTTP library preparation and bounded staging exist but are hardcoded to Hono/node-server; component smoke is not target-app reuse evidence.
StockDesk preparation uses hand-selected search queries and generic HTTP pack; runner records copied asset integrity, not complete dynamic reuse proof.

Direct named tool/model Jev selector calls were absent outside definitions/tests in searched product directories; repository selector also used by standalone verification script. This is a symbol-search result, not proof about all conceivable dynamic invocations.
SystemOne adapter has typed/size/authorization/budget gates; selectors return a narrower decision without the full receipt/probability evidence.
Standalone schema checks internal declarations but does not authenticate actual execution or independent verification; declared FAIL remains accepted regardless of otherwise positive declarations.
History default is retrieval; preserved later-source paid qualification is 53/54. New offline tests do not close that historical qualification gate.
No tracked root workflows; 12 nested workflows; inherited ci includes publishing and production deployment.
Desktop product/app/publish and Compose image defaults still point to upstream Rakazo identity/channels.
Current UI catalog projection lacks stars/language/popularity fields; human discovery library needs metadata as well as UI work.
Shared semantic dark/light/system tokens already exist; proposed concept palette is a design change, not an applied code change.
